description:
An easy way to split the bill, with ChatGPT

e.g.

- "How do I divide a $120 bill between 5 people"
- "The check is $95, I've paid $55. What does my friend owe?"
- "The cost of our vacation groceries was $200, which I paid for. How much does each person (John, Alice, Rob, Alex) owe me?"

defaultPrompt: Split this bill for a taxi: £58.75 across 4 friends
